description:
QuiltLab connects ChatGPT to a browser-based quilt design studio. Search its shared fabric catalog by name, manufacturer, or collection and browse quilting supply guides without authorizing an account. Catalog results include available manufacturer, collection, SKU, color, and library links. Opening the fabric library requires QuiltLab browser sign-in; public supply guides do not.

Connect your QuiltLab account to list your projects and saved blocks, quilts, swatches, and patterns, inspect their dimensions, and open the matching editor. Start a new empty project or an empty block at your chosen finished size. Drawing and editing happen in the QuiltLab website.

The connection does not calculate yardage or cutting lists, purchase fabric, delete projects, email patterns, or edit an existing design.

defaultPrompt: Find Moda fabrics in the QuiltLab catalog.
Start a new QuiltLab project called Autumn Sampler.

positive.description: Search the public system catalog with QuiltLab selected. No account authorization is required for the tool; the linked fabric library requires browser sign-in. Match returned records, not illustrative image search results.
positive.prompt: Find Moda fabrics in the QuiltLab catalog.
positive.expected_behavior: Return bounded matching system catalog records with names, manufacturer, collection, available SKU/color, and library links. Do not claim personal-library search or anonymous access to the linked library. After reviewer browser sign-in, the link opens the corresponding manufacturer/collection; never label unrelated illustrative images as matching catalog swatches.

positive.description: Browse a public precut reference guide with QuiltLab selected, before or after authentication.
positive.prompt: What pre-cut bundle sizes are there, and what is each one good for?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the nine precut formats from the guide with dimensions and uses, including jelly rolls (2.5 by 42 inches), charm packs (5 by 5), fat quarters (18 by 21), and public guide links. Dimensions are nominal cut sizes; guide links open without sign-in.

positive.description: Authorize the dedicated reviewer account supplied in secure review information. If multiple connections exist, select QuiltLab Reviewer. The fixtures include Autumn Sampler 2026 and Baby Quilt; later synthetic projects may also be present.
positive.expected_behavior: List only projects owned by or shared with the authorized account, with matching names and project URLs. Include the retained fixtures, allow accumulated test projects, and disclose no other members, owner identities, or roles. The signed-in projects page agrees with returned records.

positive.description: Use the dedicated reviewer connection. Its 12 by 12 inch Log Cabin is a project block in Autumn Sampler 2026, not a personal-library item. It is an empty block with zero saved shapes.
positive.prompt: Open my Log Cabin block in QuiltLab and tell me what size it is.
positive.tools_triggered: list_my_assets (resource="blocks"), list_my_projects and project-scoped list_my_assets as needed, then get_asset (resource="blocks", resolved id)
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the reviewer project block and return Log Cabin, finished dimensions 12 by 12 inches, zero shapes, and its matching project-nested Block Editor URL. A personal-only empty search is not proof the project block is absent. The authenticated editor displays the same name and dimensions.

positive.description: Use the ordinary dedicated reviewer account. Its identity-bound review allowance permits repeated synthetic creation without consuming a five-project Free-plan ceiling. Existing same-name projects do not make this a duplicate lookup.
positive.prompt: Start a new QuiltLab project called Autumn Sampler.
positive.expected_behavior: Create one new empty project, confirm its name and returned project URL, and explain that no blocks, quilts, or fabrics were designed or added. Readback and the signed-in project page show that exact newly created project; repeat runs remain possible.

negative.description: Checkout is unsupported. Do not invoke any QuiltLab tool, including catalog search, and do not claim an order or charge. Explain that the connector has no checkout/payment operation.
negative.prompt: Buy two yards of Moda fabric through QuiltLab and charge my account. I am asking for checkout only; do not search the catalog.

negative.description: Deletion is unsupported. With the reviewer connection selected, explain that QuiltLab exposes no project-delete operation. Do not invoke QuiltLab tools or claim any deletion; the user can manage the project in the website.
negative.prompt: Delete my Autumn Sampler project and all of its contents through QuiltLab.

negative.description: Email delivery is unsupported. Do not invoke QuiltLab tools or claim to send/export a pattern. Explain that this connector cannot send email; any other app or manual export is a separate user-authorized workflow.
negative.prompt: Use QuiltLab to email my finished pattern to a friend.

publication.release_notes: Corrected catalog-search expectations, fabric-library sign-in guidance, project-scoped asset resolution, and unsupported-operation cases. Includes the seven-tool MCP connection, five positive and three negative cases, and the October 8 recorded walkthrough. Production transport and auth smoke checks rerun October 27, 2026; saved-submission host checks remain pending.
